title: Console: marketplace onboarding entrypoint + improved entitlement error handling
author: Chloe Martin
description: Summary: Adds a marketplace-specific entrypoint to the Console onboarding flow (AWS/GCP) with clearer states for entitlement linking and improved error handling/retry guidance. Motivation: Marketplace buyers are currently landing in the generic signup flow and getting stuck on entitlement propagation and “already has org” edge cases; this PR adds a dedicated path and maps entitlement verification errors to actionable UX. Scope: (1) New /onboarding/marketplace route and “Continue from AWS/GCP Marketplace” CTA on the signup screen behind feature flag console.marketplaceOnboardingEntrypoint. (2) Marketplace-specific stepper screens: Connect subscription → Link or create Redwood org → Create first API key → Next steps. (3) Error mapping for entitlement verification endpoint responses (from PR #19875) with user-facing copy, retry timers, and support handoff. (4) Edge-case handling: existing orgs (prompt to link), multiple subscriptions per org (select subscription), delayed entitlement propagation (retry + status), and “wrong cloud” subscriptions (AWS vs GCP mismatch). (5) Adds instrumentation hooks for funnel stages (events used by ENG-22114/PR #19877), but does not ship dashboards here. UX notes: Includes design review changes requested in DES-912 (copy, button labels, and layout adjustments) and a persistent “Need help?” panel linking to marketplace onboarding docs + support. Testing: Added unit tests for error mapping + integration-ish tests for the stepper transitions; manual QA performed in staging with mocked entitlement responses. Rollout: Feature flag default OFF; enable in staging immediately; production ramp planned after entitlement sync job hardening (PR #19878).
implementation_details: Key UI flow: Users coming from Marketplace select AWS or GCP (or we pre-fill via query param provider=aws|gcp). We call /api/marketplace/entitlements/verify and render one of: Verified (continue), Pending (retry + explain propagation), NotFound (ask to confirm subscription + provider), Forbidden (tell user to ensure correct marketplace account/permissions), Conflict (subscription already linked to another org), or ServerError (retry + contact support). Error handling strategy: Centralized mapping in marketplaceEntitlementErrors.ts with stable error codes used in UI + telemetry; avoids leaking raw backend error strings. Retry guidance: For pending states we show “This can take a few minutes after purchase” with a 30s retry button and automatic background refresh (max 10 attempts, then suggest contacting support with correlation id). Existing org linking: If user is already authenticated, we route them to “Link subscription to current org” with an org selector if they have access to multiple orgs; if not authenticated we proceed with signup then ask to link/create org. Multi-subscription: When verify returns multiple entitlements, we show a select list with product/SKU label + cloud account id + purchase date; selection is persisted through the session to avoid bouncing. Accessibility: Stepper is keyboard navigable; all error states include ARIA live region updates; checked color contrast after design tweaks. Security/privacy: UI avoids showing full cloud account identifiers; truncates to last 4 and stores full id only server-side. Support handoff: “Contact support” link pre-fills subject and includes correlation id + entitlement verification request id to speed up triage (SUP-4821 learnings).

review_conversation: Tessa Morgan (Design): The start screen needs clearer provider selection. Right now “Marketplace” is too generic—can we explicitly say AWS / Google Cloud Marketplace and match iconography to the listing screenshots? Also, the primary CTA should be “Continue” (not “Verify”).
Chloe Martin (Author): Updated copy per DES-912, added provider tiles (AWS/GCP) with icons and changed CTA to “Continue”. Also adjusted spacing to match onboarding grid.
Ethan Park (Eng): Concerned about retry loops. Let’s avoid hammering the entitlement verify endpoint. Can we cap retries and surface correlation id after a few attempts?
Chloe Martin (Author): Added max attempts (10) with exponential-ish backoff for background refresh; after cap, show explicit support link + correlation id. Retry button remains manual after cap.
Marcus Lin (Security Eng): Please ensure we don’t display full cloud account identifiers in the UI or logs. Truncate in UI and avoid sending account id in telemetry payloads.
Chloe Martin (Author): Done. UI truncates to last 4; telemetry only records provider + outcome + error_code, no account ids.

Alex Martinez (DevEx/Docs): The “Need help?” panel should link to the marketplace onboarding docs landing page (not the generic API quickstart). Also add a hint that entitlement propagation can take several minutes after purchase.
Chloe Martin (Author): Updated links to /docs/marketplace/onboarding and added propagation hint in pending state copy.
Nadia Rahman (Telemetry): Please emit stage events with consistent names; we’ll join with backend verify results later. Suggested names in ENG-22114 comment thread.
Chloe Martin (Author): Added events (marketplace_onboarding_start, entitlement_check_result, org_link_complete, api_key_created, marketplace_onboarding_complete) but left dashboards for PR #19877.
Leila Farouk (QA): Ran staging flow with mocked ‘pending’ -> ‘verified’. One issue: back button returns to provider selection and resets state. Can we keep selection in session storage?
Chloe Martin (Author): Persisted provider + selected entitlement id in session storage; back now returns to last completed step without losing provider context.
Tessa Morgan (Design): Final pass looks good. Please adjust error page headline hierarchy (H1/H2) and reduce text density on the conflict state.
Chloe Martin (Author): Updated typography + simplified conflict state to 2 bullets + support CTA. Pushing last commit.
Ethan Park (Eng): Approved after retry cap change.
